# Rachit Mangawa

> Software Engineer specializing in low-latency systems, AI retrieval pipelines, and web interfaces. CSAI at Netaji Subhas University of Technology (NSUT), former Software Developer Intern at UIDAI (Aadhaar).

## Key Systems & Projects

- [HeartFlow OS](https://rachit-mangawa.github.io/HEARTFLOW_OS/): Deterministic edge AI telemetry system and C99 embedded transpiler. Compiles 5-model Scikit-Learn ensembles into zero-malloc C99 headers (<512B stack, 8.15KB SRAM) for microcontrollers. 18.4µs on-device inference with -76.4% INT8 SRAM reduction.
- [HF Pluggable Gateway](https://rachit-mangawa.github.io/hf-backend/): Sub-100ms API aggregation gateway hosting isolated Python subprojects in Docker on Hugging Face Spaces.
- [Semantic Comment Analyzer](https://rachit-mangawa.github.io/Semantic-Comment-Analyze/): Sub-15ms NLP intent classification engine using all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings with exact word-level token occlusion explainability and constant ~45MB RAM streaming.
- [Vera AI Engine](https://github.com/rachit-mangawa/vera-engine): 4-tier fail-fast AI orchestrator cascade (NVIDIA NIM -> Groq -> Gemini -> Local Qwen SLM via llama-cpp-python with strict LlamaGrammar enforcement) for the magicpin Vera AI Challenge.

## Upstream Open Source

- [TensorFlow Core](https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/pull/120944): Numerical autodiff gradient fix in tf.math.bessel_i1 at x=0 (Merged, PR #120944, Issue #120578).
